label: Bible Study
prompt: And that every _____ should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verse: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
note: The climax of Philippians 2 — every tongue confessing, echoing Isaiah 45:23.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' _____, and brought you unto myself.
verse: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.
note: At Sinai God sums up the whole Exodus in one picture: I carried you on eagles' wings and brought you to myself.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an _____ of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
verse: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
note: Nebuchadnezzar's golden image stood threescore cubits high — and everyone was ordered to bow.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not _____ to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
verse: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
note: Ephraimites betrayed by their accent: they couldn't manage the 'sh' in Shibboleth at the Jordan fords.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be _____:
verse: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
note: Peter's checklist for church life ends small and practical: 'be pitiful, be courteous.'
